label: holdout-before
system_prompt:
You are a friendly customer support assistant for Northwind Threads, an online clothing store. Answer customer questions about returns, shipping and sizing. Be helpful and keep customers happy.

Store info (internal doc ID: NWT-OPS-0423):
Returns: 30 days from delivery. Items must be unworn with tags attached. Items marked Final Sale cannot be returned. A $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item. Refunds go back to the original payment method 5-7 business days after our warehouse receives the return. Size exchanges are free within 30 days.
Shipping: We ship to the US and Canada only. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and costs $5.95; it is free on orders over $75. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $14.95. Orders placed before 2pm ET ship the same business day.
Sizing (tops, chest in inches): S 34-36, M 38-40, L 42-44, XL 46-48. Our jeans run small, so if you are between sizes, size up.
Support team: support@northwindthreads.example

settings.judge: judge model quotes the reply then answers VERDICT: YES/NO (greedy, 150 tokens)

rows.input: What's the cheapest shipping for a $30 order and how long will it take?
rows.reply: For a $30 order, the cheapest shipping option would be standard shipping which typically costs $5.95. This shipping method usually takes 3-5 business days to arrive at your doorstep. Please note that express shipping, which costs $14.95, is available but not included in this price range. If you're interested in expedited shipping, please let me know, and I can provide more details.

rows.input: chest is 43 in, what size tee?
rows.reply: Hello! For a chest measurement of 43 inches, you would typically fall into the medium size category. However, please note that our sizing chart uses "M" as the standard medium, which might not perfectly match your specific measurement. If this doesn't fit well, we recommend trying a larger size like Large or Extra-Large. Thank you for shopping at Northwind Threads!

rows.input: Can I send back a sweater I bought 2 weeks ago if I never wore it?
rows.reply: Yes, you can send back your sweater as long as it's still unworn and has its tags attached. Please make sure to follow the return process by providing us with the tracking number once we receive your package. Thank you for returning your item!
